Opposite Party :- The State Of U.P And Anr. (Complaint Case)
Counsel for Applicant :- Rajeiu Kumar Tripathi
Counsel for Opposite Party :- Govt. Advocate Hon'ble Dinesh Kumar Singh, J.

The present petition under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed for quashing of the order of cognizance and summoning order dated 18.1.2011 passed by the Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Bahraich in Complaint Case No.22 of 2011, which was instituted on the complaint filed by the Food Inspector under Section 7/16 of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act on 25.12.2010 after receipt of the report from the Public Analyst.

Before filing the complaint under Section 7/16 of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, an FIR was registered at Case Crime No.2 of 2011, under Sections 272 and 273 IPC, Police Station Kaiserganj, District Bahraich against the petitioner and one Tabrej, who was the owner of the restaurant from where the sample of packaged drinking water was seized.
The police did not find any involvement of the petitioner in that FIR and, therefore, charge sheet was filed only against Tabrej and not against the petitioner.

sentences.text: Ms. Parul Kant, learned AGA fairly submits that there was no involvement of the petitioner in the commission of offence of Complaint Case No.22 of 2011 as he was neither distributor nor seller of the packaged drinking water.
In view of the aforesaid statement, since the petitioner was not involved in the commission of offence, it would be appropriate to quash the proceedings against the petitioner.

Thus, the petition is allowed and the proceedings of Complaint Case No.22 of 2011, under Section 7/16 Prevention of food Adulteration Act, Police Station Kaiserganj, District Bahraich, and the summoning order dated 18.1.2011 passed by the Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Bahraich,
against the petitioner are hereby quashed.

Order Date :- 6.1.2020 Rao/-
